title: Подія цифрової фіксації
roles: R03; R01 для первинної польової фіксації
fields_and_relations: Пристрій/оператор/ПЗ, recording_form, settings, час, ordered files.
required_interaction: Додати outputs/manifest; recapture створює нові подію й файли, born-digital не вимагає носія.

implementation.view_model: Capture provenance, ordered outputs, immutable files and manifest; new capture/representation/files on repeat; session capture without physical object
limitations: 2 MiB total per capture; localStorage quota; browser recording up to 30 seconds.
Scanner and capture-card drivers, long recordings and remote storage are outside this prototype.
File header checks and declared settings do not replace instrumental QC; codec previews depend on browser support.
Historical text fixtures remain readable; new job captures require real binary files.
implementation.state_storage: Normalized browser store v9; preserves existing user data. Older unstructured preparations require explicit review.
permissions: media.write / physical.write / intake.send / intake.receive / legacy.write / legacy.review / capture.field, explicit archive grants
implementation.atomicity: Authorize and compare expected revision/package state; mutate clone; validate FK/type/version/hash; commit atomically.
implementation.preparation_gate: A job capture requires current confirmed preparation, condition evidence and unexpired custody. Pins exact profile and preparation in settings; expands planned output counts.
implementation.digitization: WF-11: binary files or browser camera/microphone; ordered composite plan mapping; explicit provenance, deviations and recapture; immutable originals and downloadable manifest/files.
implementation.quality_handoff: WF-12: exact representation QC, recalculated checksums, parameter comparisons and per-file evidence; known-defect acceptance or explicit recapture; linked issue resolution only after acceptance.
